title: The ordinary scalar tensor comparison square
statement: For commutative condensed rings R and S, an exact coefficient extension a, a scheme Z, the fixed basic scalar comparison data d and its normalization hypotheses h, and arbitrary internal R-modules M,N, the composite ES(delta_internal(M,N)), followed by the ordinary section tensor comparison and o_M tensor o_N, equals o_(M tensor N), followed by the section scalar image of the ordinary R tensor comparison and the ordinary scalar tensorator specified by d.m.

source.place: Tag 07A4, degreewise ordinary tensor compatibility and signed direct-sum totalization; Modules on Sites, Tags 03EK and 03EL.

proof.text: Precompose with the scalar extension coequalizer, the internal relative tensor coequalizer, and the sheaf tensor comparison maps. Local equivalence and tensor induction reduce equality to generators s tensor (x tensor y).
The normalized internal scalar tensorator sends the scalar unit on x tensor y to the tensor of the scalar units on x and y. Scalar linearity determines its value on every generator.

Apply hgenerator, naturality of the sheafified scalar pure generator, the ordinary section tensor pure formula, and hmonoidal. Both composites send s tensor (x tensor y) to (s tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y).

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4, the ordinary comparison and the passage to unbounded total complexes.

theorem coefficientScalarTensor_ordinary (Z : Scheme.{u})
    (d : CoefficientScalarTensorRepresentativeBasicData a Z)
    (h : CoefficientScalarTensorRepresentativeHypotheses a Z d)
    (M N : ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules R Z) :
    let := internalScalarMonoidal a Z
    (ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence S Z).functor.map
        (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a Z)) M N) ≫
      (ModuleRingedComparison.ordinaryTensorComparison S Z _ _).hom ≫
      (d.o.hom.app M ⊗ₘ d.o.hom.app N) =
    d.o.hom.app (M ⊗ N) ≫
      d.b.extension.map (ModuleRingedComparison.ordinaryTensorComparison R Z M N).hom ≫
      d.m.toOplaxMonoidal.δ
        ((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence R Z).functor.obj M)
        ((ModuleRingedComparison.equivalence R Z).functor.obj N)
